body:
Hey there! Writing copy, blogs, and content is eating up your week—but what if AI could handle the heavy lifting? We've rounded up the best writing assistants that small business owners are actually using.

## This Week's Top Picks

**Notion AI**
Write, summarize, and brainstorm without leaving your workspace. Best for: Teams already using Notion who want AI built into their existing workflow. *Free + $10/mo* — [Try Notion AI Free →](https://notion.so/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Copy.ai**
Generate marketing copy, social posts, and email sequences in seconds. Best for: Founders and marketers who need fast iterations on ad copy and headlines. *Free + $36/mo* — [Try Copy.ai Free →](https://copy.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Jasper**
AI writing assistant built specifically for marketing teams with brand voice customization. Best for: Agencies and scaling businesses that need consistent tone across campaigns. *$49/mo* — [Try Jasper Free →](https://jasper.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)

---

## Quick Tip

Don't just copy-paste AI output—use it as your first draft, then add your voice. AI is best at speed and structure; you're best at personality and specifics. Spend 5 minutes editing rather than 30 minutes staring at a blank page, and you'll actually finish projects.
